##### Project general facts

Chelsea Gardens is a boutique residential building by Alaia Developments that combines contemporary design with premium finishes and a calm, green setting. The project offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, alongside a small number of retail units at ground level, creating an intimate address for residents who value quality and privacy in the heart of the city.

Shared facilities are designed for relaxation and wellness. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool and a rooftop pool with open city views, a fully equipped gym and a dedicated yoga area. Landscaped seating areas provide quiet spaces to unwind, while a modern lobby creates a welcoming first impression for residents and guests.

Apartments are delivered semi-furnished, with kitchens fitted with built-in appliances and contemporary fittings. Living rooms and bedrooms are designed with clean lines and a refined palette, creating bright and comfortable interiors for everyday living.    

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a central residential neighbourhood located between Sheikh Zayed Road and the established districts of Satwa and Jumeirah. The area is undergoing a transformation into a modern, walkable community with educational, healthcare, sports and recreational facilities, as well as shopping and dining options close at hand.

Sheikh Zayed Road is moments away, while City Walk, Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, DIFC and Dubai World Trade Centre are all within a short drive. Dubai Water Canal and La Mer beach are also close by, and Dubai International Airport is easily accessible.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of a central location, proximity to the city's main business districts and a boutique residential offer positions the area for both end users and investors seeking well-connected apartment living in central Dubai.
